description: React component for managing categories in a Todo application, including listing, adding, editing, deleting, and favoriting categories with UI dialogs and interactions.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Deletes a category, updates user state, and shows a toast notification.

methods.name: handleNameChange
methods.description: Handles change in new category name input, validates length.

methods.name: handleEditNameChange
methods.description: Handles change in category edit name input, validates length.

methods.name: handleAddCategory
methods.description: Creates a new category, updates user state, and shows a toast.

methods.name: handleEditDimiss
methods.description: Resets edit dialog state and fields.

methods.name: handleEditCategory
methods.description: Saves updates to an existing category and shows a toast.

methods.name: getAssociatedTasks
methods.description: Returns tasks associated with a specific category.
